description_en: Queries all messages within a specified topic during a specified time range by paging. You can pass in the topic name and time range for the query
description_zh: 通过传入 Topic 名称和时间段，分页查询指定时间段内 Topic 内的所有消息
kebab_example: aliyun sofa query-mq-sofamq-message-by-topic --begin-time 1570723200000 --cell RZ01A --end-time 1570809600000 --instance-id MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --page-num 1 --page-size 20 --task-id 0BC1310300002A9F000021E4D7A48346 --topic test-mq_topic --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMqSofamqMessageByTopic

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the query range
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的起始时间戳
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the query range
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的终止时间戳
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the messages belong. This parameter is required for instances that have independent namespaces
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消息所对应的实例 ID。针对有独立命名空间的实例，该参数为必填
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the query task. This parameter is not required for the first query. For subsequent queries, this parameter is required. Obtain the value from the response of the previous query
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务的 ID。首次查询不需要输入，后续取消息必须传入，根据前一次的返回结果取出该字段
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The topic name of the messages to query

parameters.name: topic
